# Original native release metadata

These YAML files were extracted from GitHub Actions installer artifacts using HTTP ranges, without downloading the historical binaries. They contain only distribution metadata generated by Electron Builder. Tests validate filename/target coverage; the synthetic installer fixtures separately exercise byte/hash verification. These files do not establish installed-app or upgrade success and are not a combined publication inventory.

| Target      | Run         | Artifact    |

| windows-x64 | 37679956573 | 11510020171 |

| linux-arm64 | 37679956573 | 11509429076 |

| mac-arm64   | 37858644344 | 11585576142 |

The macOS ARM64 job succeeded in the later run before that overall run was cancelled to correct Linux validation rules. Preserve these original filenames/checksums when extending coverage tests. Never use these fixtures as upload inputs.
